snippet.title: The Alters - Expedition Logs Episode 4 - FGS Live From gamescom latam
snippet.description:
In this new ‘Expedition Log’ that debuted in FGS Live From gamescom latam, we take a special look at how you can harvest resources and build mining equipment in the treacherous alien world. As your technical ability grows, you’ll be able to accelerate food production and allow fast travel. The Alters is an emotional sci-fi survival game where you help Jan Dolski, the sole survivor of an ill-fated space expedition, create alternative versions of himself to escape a hostile planet and tackle personal turmoils with an unconventional crew. The Alters will be released on June 13 on PlayStation, Xbox, and PC, available to wishlist / pre-order on GOG.com, Epic Games Store and Steam.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow
